leadText: Volume 1 is the first volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 1: Fussing and Fighting
Adventure 2: Choices
Adventure 3: A Nickname for Tepig
Adventure 4: Black's First Trainer Battle

==Important events==
starts his journey to beat the Pokémon League.

Black meets Andy and learns about Triple Battles.

==Party changes==
===Additions===

Cheren's in PS462.
Bianca's in PS462.
